Protection.title: Protections
Protection.unavailable: Protection could not be applied. Check the source, recipients, declarations and resources.
Protection.activationHint: Activate this protection as an action, paying its Intellect cost after Edge. Canceling spends nothing.
Protection.elementalHint: The caster is always included. Choose every other protected creature and declare one energy type. Each creature's own one-hour or longer recovery ends only their protection. NPCs take 3 less damage per severity step.
Protection.untyped: Leave empty for untyped damage or the existing damage tags
Protection.inRange: All selected creatures are within immediate range.
Protection.debris: Nearby small objects are available to intercept attacks.
Protection.mageBlock: For Block, use active Mage Armor and Intellect instead of Might.
Protection.abandonHint: End this partial activation without refunding its cost. Its retained receipts grant no protection.
Protection.npcRestHint: Confirm this NPC completed a one-hour or longer rest. This expires their protection without restoring Health or affecting other creatures.
Protection.environmentHint: Tracked Ability protection applies automatically for the declared energy. Do not include that same protection again in the manual reductions below.
